definition: The Wages Code creates **offences** for breaches such as paying below minimum wage, unauthorised deductions, failure to maintain registers, and obstruction of inspectors. Penalties include **fines** (higher for repeat offences) and continuing offences may attract **daily fines**. Corporate employers may expose officers to liability when offence committed with consent or neglect.

statutoryReferences.note: Note which offences are compoundable if provided
